routes.name: Alpha Beta Gamer
routes.whyItFits: Its official page asks for games still in development and requires public access or downloads to be free. Mythical Void is an early-access game that starts in a browser without an account or download.
routes.importantBoundary: The outlet says every submission is read but coverage is not guaranteed. Images or YouTube footage are appreciated, not promised by this pack.
routes.subject: Game submission: Mythical Void — a free alien-creature browser adventure
routes.body:
Hi Alpha Beta Gamer,

My son and I began Mythical Void at home in Ireland, using our imagination and today’s AI tools. We kept working until it became a real browser game.

Players hatch an alien creature shaped by a genetics system, cross six damaged realms, free their Guardians from the Void and decide what Project Beacon should become. It is free, in early access, and starts without a download or account.

Play: https://mythicalvoid.com/play/
Press and background: https://mythicalvoid.com/press/

AI helped us create, but people made the story, safety and release decisions. Optional learning moments use credited public NASA material; NASA does not endorse the game.

If it looks suitable for your readers or channels, I would be grateful if you tried the opening. I understand that a submission does not guarantee coverage.

Kind regards,
Kevin
Mythical Void

routes.name: Indie Games Plus
routes.whyItFits: Its public contact page invites developers to share games, while its editorial description emphasizes unusual independent games and the people who make them.
routes.importantBoundary: This is an editorial suggestion, not a request for paid coverage. The pitch leads with the playable idea and human origin rather than claims about popularity.
routes.subject: For consideration: Mythical Void, a father-and-son browser adventure
routes.body:
Hi Indie Games Plus,

My son and I started Mythical Void by asking strange questions at home in Ireland: what could live where gravity points sideways, and how different could each creature become? That experiment is now a free browser adventure.

Players hatch an alien creature shaped by a genetics system, cross six living realms, rescue their Guardians and decide what Project Beacon should become. It starts without an account or download.

Play: https://mythicalvoid.com/play/
Studio story and press material: https://mythicalvoid.com/press/

Generative AI helped with parts of the creative process, while people remained responsible for the story, safety, testing and release. Optional learning moments use credited public NASA material; NASA does not endorse Mythical Void.

If the game or its origin feels relevant to your coverage, I would be glad for you to try it. There is no expectation of coverage.

Kind regards,
Kevin
Mythical Void
